about.label: Our Story
about.title:
Cinematic Vision,
{em}Human Heart{/em}
paragraphs: We create {strong}emotions and memories{/strong}, telling your story through a cinematic touch. Every frame is intentional. Every light, deliberate. Every memory, permanent.
Born from a love of film and a deep respect for human connection, CineLensStudios brings a director's eye to every shoot — whether it's a whispered vow or a boardroom headshot.
We don't just take photographs. We {strong}craft visual narratives{/strong} that you'll return to, again and again.
about.quote: We capture the feeling, not just the moment.

items.title: We Create Memories
items.desc: Photography is the act of preserving time. We approach every session knowing these images will be passed down, revisited, and cherished for decades.

items.title: We Capture Emotions
items.desc: The real magic isn't the backdrop or the lighting — it's the unguarded laugh, the tearful glance, the weight of a hand held tight. That's what we hunt for.

items.title: We Work With Your Vision
items.desc: Every story is different. We listen first, shoot second. Your vision shapes our direction, and our craft makes it extraordinary.

contactPage.title:
Let's Create
Something {em}Cinematic{/em}
contactPage.subtitle: Have a question, a project in mind, or just want to say hello? We'd genuinely love to hear from you. Every great shoot starts with a conversation.
contactPage.formSubtitle: Fill out the form and we'll get back to you within 24 hours. Prefer a quicker chat? WhatsApp us directly.
contactPage.successMessage: Thank you for reaching out. We'll read your message today and get back to you within 24 hours. Looking forward to hearing your story.

contact.question: How quickly do you respond to enquiries?
contact.answer: We respond to all messages within 24 hours on weekdays, typically much sooner. WhatsApp is the fastest way to reach us if you need an urgent response.

contact.question: Can I visit the studio before booking?
contact.answer: Absolutely — we love meeting clients in person. Drop us a message to schedule a studio visit. We'll walk you through our work, equipment, and answer any questions over a cup of chai.

contact.question: Do you offer consultations before a shoot?
contact.answer: Yes. Every Full Day package includes a dedicated pre-shoot consultation. For other packages, we offer a complimentary 30-minute call to discuss your vision, references, and expectations.

contact.question: What if I'm not sure which package to choose?
contact.answer: That's what we're here for! Send us a message with a few details about your shoot — the occasion, date, number of people, and location — and we'll recommend the best-fit package with honest advice.

contact.question: Do you collaborate with other vendors?
contact.answer: Yes — we regularly collaborate with makeup artists, event planners, florists, and venues across India. If you need referrals, just ask and we'll connect you with trusted partners from our network.

packages.question: How do I confirm my booking date?
packages.answer: Fill out the booking form and we'll reach out within 24 hours to confirm availability. A 30% advance payment secures your date. We accept UPI, bank transfer, and all major cards.

packages.question: Can I customise a package?
packages.answer: Absolutely. Every shoot is different. Reach out via WhatsApp or the booking form and we'll create a custom quote based on your specific needs, location, and vision.

packages.question: What if I need to reschedule?
packages.answer: We allow one free reschedule up to 7 days before the shoot. Rescheduling within 7 days may incur a small fee depending on availability. We always try to accommodate our clients.

packages.question: How are photos delivered?
packages.answer: All photos are delivered via a private, password-protected online gallery. You can download high-resolution versions directly. USB drives and printed albums are shipped to your address.

packages.question: Do you travel for destination shoots?
packages.answer: Yes! We've shot across India and internationally. Travel fees apply for destinations outside Mumbai. Contact us for a destination quote — we love adventure.

packages.question: What is your editing style?
packages.answer: Our editing is cinematic, natural, and emotive. We use a signature colour grade that draws on film photography — warm highlights, cool shadows, and deep blacks. We avoid heavy filters or overly processed looks.

origin.label: Where It Began
origin.title:
Born From a
Love of {em}Film{/em}
paragraphs: CineLensStudios was founded in 2025 by {strong}Pratham Khamkar{/strong}, a self-taught photographer who fell in love with the language of cinema long before he ever picked up a camera.

Growing up watching the way a single frame in a film could hold an entire lifetime of emotion, Pratham became obsessed with bringing that same deliberateness to still photography. Every composition, every light decision, every moment of stillness — intentional.

What started as a {strong}one-person passion project{/strong} in a Mumbai apartment has grown into a team of six storytellers, covering everything from grand destination weddings to quiet executive portraits.
origin.quote: I never wanted to be a photographer who just showed up with a camera. I wanted to be a storyteller who happened to use one.

philosophy.label: How We Think
philosophy.title: Our {em}Philosophy{/em}
philosophy.subtitle: Three principles that guide every shoot, every edit, every delivery we make.

items.title: Presence Over Performance
items.desc: We don't direct people into poses. We create an environment where genuine moments emerge on their own. The camera finds you — not the other way around.

items.title: Light as Language
items.desc: Every shoot is a study in available light. We chase golden hours, lean into shadows, and treat the sun as a collaborator. Artificial lighting is a last resort, never a default.

items.title: Story First, Always
items.desc: Before we touch the shutter, we understand the narrative. What chapter of your life is this? What should someone feel when they look at this frame in thirty years?

values.label: What We Stand For
values.title:
The Things We'll
{em}Never Compromise{/em}
values.intro: Some studios promise everything. We promise only what we believe in. These aren't marketing words — they're the commitments we make to every person who trusts us with their story.

items.name: Honesty about what we can deliver
items.desc: We never oversell. If a vision isn't feasible, we say so — and offer something better.

items.name: Respect for your timeline
items.desc: Delivery dates are promises, not estimates. We've never missed one.

items.name: Your comfort comes first
items.desc: A relaxed subject is a beautiful subject. We do everything possible to make you forget we're there.

items.name: No cookie-cutter sessions
items.desc: Every brief is read. Every story is different. We don't reuse shot-lists or presets across clients.
